metadata.name: Pickerlock
metadata.desc: A simple lock picking game made for 20 Second Game Jam 2025.

info.content: You don't know how and when you decided to do so, but somehow, you found yourself enrolled in a lock picking contest. No prize, no praise, just 20 seconds and a chance to show off your speed. There is one simple rule: NO MISTAKES! Otherwise, you're out!

info.title: Instructions
items: You need to open as many locks as you can in 20 seconds.
Open each lock by pressing arrow keys in the order given on screen.
As you crack each lock successfully, you will be given new ones.
But be careful! Once you make a wrong move, you will immediately be disqualified.
You can see your high scores on difficulties menu. Try to beat your record in each level of difficulties! Challenge yourself!
